spec: docs/I24_DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS.md §8.4.5 (criteria fixed 2026-10-07 before any run of the round)
status: PROPOSED, not adopted; adoption of B1, of the refit level, or of either family is the owner's call

part_i.keys: criteria and reported as harness/corridor_b1.py evaluate_arm writes them: 'reference' is B2 alone, 'b1' is B1 + B2

A1.rule: 0 collisions in every run; steps below -8.9 m/s^2 not above the reference

A2.rule: 5,400-m 2-h flow within 5,829-6,309 veh/h; boundary-zone mean speed error smaller in magnitude than the reference's

zone.estimator: per replicate, the unweighted mean of the 30-s window Edie speeds on the schedule's grid (as the schedule's study-window mean); then the replicate mean

edie_2h_reported.what: one Edie speed over the zone's cells in the whole study window (vehicle-time weighted; A2's first estimator, replaced 2026-10-07 before any p12 result was read)

A3.rule: realised demand >= the reference's (FRISCO_PROTOCOL Amendment 2 clarification)

A4.rule: the profile's wave verdict unchanged where it passes today; backward fronts per replicate not below the reference by more than a third (standard and stripe detectors)

reference.detail: detector: stack: slant-stack peak of the two-way demeaned field on 15 s x 75 m bins over front speeds [-40, -2] km/h in 0.25 km/h steps, peak/median contrast >= 3, edge peaks rejected; no backward wave detected

b1.detail: detector: stack: slant-stack peak of the two-way demeaned field on 15 s x 75 m bins over front speeds [-40, -2] km/h in 0.25 km/h steps, peak/median contrast >= 3, edge peaks rejected; no backward wave detected

wave_verdict.note: the reference fails the wave criterion here; the verdict half does not apply

A5.rule: 15-min segment-speed RMSPE not above the reference + 0.02

lane_shares.why: per-lane section crossings are recorded only in the trajectories (lane at each section); meta.json, vehicles.parquet and the battery artifact do not carry them

b2.name: wave_speed
b2.threshold: backward wave speed in [14, 22] km/h (emergent, unseeded)

b2.name: sensitivity_grid
b2.threshold: penetration {1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%} x compliance {25%, 50%, 80%, 100%} grid published with CIs

b2.name: no_collisions
b2.threshold: zero SUMO collisions in every run, each run recording the counter

b2.name: no_locks
b2.threshold: no run locked (no queue standing without discharge for 10 min or more), every run recorded

r1_r5_second_arm.status: reported, not gating: the reference is the committed stage-p12 battery, not re-run here
r1_r5_second_arm.r3_reference_half: not computed: stage p12 archived no vehicles.parquet

quoted_figures.what: figures the §8.4.5 write-up quotes beside the criteria, from the batteries read above; reported, not gating; see estimators

collapsed_seed.rule: the B1 + B2 replicate with the lowest realised demand share

rmspe_5min_per_replicate_paired.source: each battery's rmspe.per_replicate_vs_observed (one seed's 5-min field against the observed one, as scripts/i24_validate.py records it)

rmspe_15min_per_replicate_paired.source: rmspe_15min_per_replicate (harness/corridor_b1.py battery); all_seeds is criteria.A5's per_replicate_paired_b1_minus_ref

zone_speed_paired_kmh.source: zone_speed_ms (A2's estimator); all_seeds is criteria.A2.zone's paired_zone_speed_b1_minus_ref_kmh

estimators.gated: A5's values (and part (ii)'s C4's) are RMSPEs of the replicate-mean field: the replicates' mean 5-min segment-speed field, in 15-min windows, against the observed field (harness/corridor_b1.py battery 'rmspe_15min'); a battery's 'rmspe.value' (reported.rmspe_5min) is the same estimator in 5-min windows
estimators.intervals: a bracketed [mean, lo95, hi95] of RMSPEs is a 95% t-interval (harness/corridor_b1.py ci, paired) of the per-seed differences of per-replicate RMSPEs (each replicate's own field against the observed one: 'rmspe_15min_per_replicate', or the battery's 'rmspe.per_replicate_vs_observed' in 5-min windows), B1 + B2 minus B2 at the same seed; its mean is not the difference of the gated values (the RMSPE of a mean field is not the mean of the replicates' RMSPEs)

wave_row.detail: detector: stack: slant-stack peak of the two-way demeaned field on 15 s x 75 m bins over front speeds [-40, -2] km/h in 0.25 km/h steps, peak/median contrast >= 3, edge peaks rejected; no backward wave detected

detector: stack: slant-stack peak of the two-way demeaned field on 15 s x 75 m bins over front speeds [-40, -2] km/h in 0.25 km/h steps, peak/median contrast >= 3, edge peaks rejected; no backward wave detected

reading.rule: A1-A5 all hold on B1 + B2 against B2 alone, and nothing recorded under problems

part_ii_rule: the re-sequence runs on B1 + B2 when part (i)'s reading holds, on B2 alone when it does not, and not at all when it is undetermined (holds None)

insertion_reanalysis_reported.what: what the fitter's --min-inserted 0.98 rule would choose from the same recorded runs (scripts/i24_fit_demand_scale.py analyze_fit): a re-analysis, not a calibration; the stage ran the fit as p4 did

by_threshold.reason: best speed_rmspe among the 4 of 12 scales whose inserted fraction is >= 0.98; the unconstrained best, s = 1.125, inserts 0.7828

C2.rule: mean realised share >= the from-arm's - 0.01 (FRISCO_PROTOCOL Amendment 2 clarification: no winning by backlog)

C3.rule: hourly link-flow GEH < 5 share not below the from-arm's

C5.rule: the wave verdict unchanged where the from-arm passes
C5.note: the from-arm fails the wave row; C5 does not bind
